'''Starting Domains''' defines the standardized territorial allocation granted to every sovereign realm across Calradia in ''Realms of Dust''.  == Domain Composition == Every recognized realm?including the player's sovereign faction?starts the campaign with an identical foundational domain: * '''1 Capital (Town):''' The primary administrative seat, economic marketplace, and cultural core of the realm. * '''1 Stronghold (Castle):''' The fortified military bastion, positioned in geographic proximity to the capital. * '''4 Bound Villages:''' Exactly four agrarian and resource settlements tied to the realm (2 bound to the Capital, 2 bound to the Stronghold).  == Settlement Baselines == To guarantee economic parity on Day 1, all starting settlements initialize with uniform economic foundations: * '''Town Prosperity:''' 3,000 baseline prosperity. * '''Castle Prosperity:''' 1,200 baseline prosperity. * '''Village Hearths:''' 300 hearths per bound village. * '''Food Reserves:''' 30 days of stored grain and food rations in granaries. * '''Settlement Loyalty:''' 70 baseline loyalty (ensuring political stability). * '''Settlement Security:''' 60 baseline security (sufficient to prevent early civic unrest). * '''Settlement Wall Levels:''' Tier 1 defensive walls.  == Geographic Clustering == Holdings are paired based on dynamic geographic Euclidean proximity to ensure contiguous, defendable borders without split or disjointed enclaves.
